## Flagship Products & Key Works

### 1. SkillFarm (Flagship Shipped Product)
- **URL**: https://skillfarm.in
- **Description**: An AI-powered workspace and personalized learning system helping software engineers transform theoretical knowledge into real production code with autonomous AI mentors.
- **Key Features**: Supervisor-led multi-agent delegation pattern, persistent semantic user memory with Mem0, real-time documentation crawling with Tavily API, and high-concurrency relational data storage.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Mem0, Google Gemini API, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. P2Shield (Autonomous LLM Privacy Firewall Proxy)
- **Live Demo**: https://p2shield-theta.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ravindra-builds/P2Shield
- **Role & Team**: Led the development of P2Shield with Team TechKnights.
- **Honors**: 1st Place Winner among 52 competing teams, ₹20,000 cash prize at Martinovation 2026.
- **Description**: High-speed client-side LLM privacy firewall proxy that detects sensitive credentials and PII with pattern-based detection, replaces them with context-preserving synthetic surrogates, and uses an AES-256-GCM encrypted token vault for secure bidirectional unmasking.
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js 16, Google Gemini API, OpenAI API.

### 3. ChaiBookLM (Contextual Vector RAG Assistant)
- **Live Demo**: https://chai-book-lm-orpin.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ravindra-builds/ChaiBookLM
- **Description**: Document research assistant for dense technical documents featuring Qdrant Vector DB, semantic chunking, and Cloudflare R2 object storage.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, Qdrant Vector DB, Prisma ORM, Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, Clerk.

### 4. ConvoX (Distributed WebSocket Chat System)
- **Live Demo**: https://convox-60nt.onrender.com
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ravindra-builds/ConvoX
- **Description**: Full-duplex messaging platform with Redis Pub/Sub syncing WebSocket events horizontally across instances.
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Socket.IO, Redis, MongoDB, Docker.

### 5. ChatMate (Multi-Model Chat Platform with Streaming & Branching)
- **Live Demo**: https://chat-mate-jade-one.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ravindra-builds/Chat-mate
- **Description**: Production multi-model chat platform featuring token-by-token Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, dynamic routing between OpenAI GPT-4o and Google Gemini, tool calling, and conversation tree branching UI.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Tailwind CSS.

## Freelance Services & Client Solutions

Ravindra is available for freelance contracts and engineering consulting in the following areas:
1. **Generative AI & LLM Application Development**: Custom RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, tool-calling bots, and multi-model routing systems with OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude.
2. **Full-Stack SaaS MVP Engineering**: Building fast, production-ready web applications from scratch with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and modern authentication.
3. **Database Architecture & ORM Migration**: Designing normalized PostgreSQL schemas with Drizzle ORM, implementing Redis caching layers, and optimizing query performance.
4. **LLM Privacy & Security Proxies**: Implementing cryptographic PII redaction and enterprise security firewalls before queries hit third-party LLMs.
